decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-238 MODIFY covering the repaired-leak precondition, continuous operation, both plumbing paths without leaks, and the other required video elements.
The same-message requirement that both stations run simultaneously is already represented; the leak-free plumbing acceptance condition adds no further dual-station state change.
Leak-free continuous operation does not change the dispensing path's removal, flushing, sanitation-access, or liquid-trap requirements.
The source does not change the valve, button control, flow behavior, or dispensing sequence; dispensing from both spouts is a demonstration criterion consistent with the existing requirement.
The plumbing repair and leak-free acceptance condition do not alter spout geometry, orientation, material, mounting location, or pour direction.
The source decision does not alter the platform height, footprint, configuration, or cup-clearance requirement.
The source requires both plumbing paths to operate without leaks but does not add or change the distinct requirement that liquid be kept out of the base and electrical components.
Several minutes of operation is a leak-test and video acceptance condition, not a change to motor durability or maximum-speed duty constraints.
The plumbing repair and leak-free demonstration condition do not revise any component selection, compatibility rule, or BOM deliverable.
The source does not modify electrical load support, power-supply capacity, controller configuration, or overload margin.
The source does not change mixing quality, foam performance, whisk selection, positioning, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The client acknowledges sturdiness but changes only the plumbing leak acceptance condition; structural stability remains valid unchanged and is already supported by the preceding test report.
